speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg. To determine the cause, can you tell me how severe this pain is on a scale of 1 to 10, and does it travel below your knee?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lumbar Radiculopathy (likely L5 or S1 root irritation).

Thank you for those details; the sudden onset during exercise with pain radiating to the foot is highly suggestive of a nerve root issue. To confirm this and rule out cauda equina syndrome, please describe exactly which toes you have numbness or weakness in, and do you have any issues controlling your bladder or bowel?
